title: Version Baseline Sync v5
description: Daily workflow: fetch latest OneAgent release + ESS oldest supported from docs and store as custom event. Also collects RUM Classic JS library version per app and stores per-app custom events.
guide:
## Setup

In both JavaScript tasks (store_baseline_event and sync_rum_classic_js_versions), replace CREDENTIALS_VAULT-YOUR_CREDENTIAL_ID with a Credential Vault ID in this format:
- CREDENTIALS_VAULT-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

RUM_TOKEN_VAULT_ID must be a Credential Vault ID (token entry), not a Dynatrace token ID from Access Tokens UI.

Token permissions needed: RumJavaScriptTagManagement + events.ingest
Optional for best-effort human-readable RUM tag labels: rumManualInsertionTags.read

Runtime URL handling is automatic: the script reads the environment URL via @dynatrace-sdk/app-environment and converts .apps. hostnames to the classic API domain before calling /api/v1/rum/* and /api/v2/events/ingest.

If /api/v1/rum/jsConfiguredVersions does not expose an explicit legacy-browser support floor, the workflow falls back to the effective target version so the run does not fail.

Run once manually and confirm OneAgentBaseline|..., RUMJSVersion|..., RUMJSVersionSyncSummary|..., RUMJSBaseline|..., and RUMJSPolicySummary|... events appear.
